问题: 统计华北地区的销售总额
考察点: 多表关联 值过滤
模型SQL: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region d ON f.region_id = d.region_id WHERE d.region_name = '华北'

问题: 统计2025年第一季度各大区的GMV，并按GMV从高到低排序
考察点: 指标口径 时间过滤 排序
模型SQL: SELECT d.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date t ON f.date_id = t.date_id JOIN dim_region d ON f.region_id = d.region_id WHERE t.year = 2025 AND t.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY d.region_name ORDER BY GMV DESC

问题: 2025年3月各商品品类的销量和销售额
考察点: 时间过滤 分组聚合
模型SQL: SELECT p.category AS 商品品类, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.date_id BETWEEN 20250301 AND 20250331 GROUP BY p.category

问题: 华南地区2025年第一季度销售总额最高的前5个商品
考察点: 四表关联 时间过滤 TopN
模型SQL:
SELECT
    p.product_name AS 商品名称,
    SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售总额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE r.region_name = '华南'
  AND d.date_id >= 20250101
  AND d.date_id <= 20250331
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY 销售总额 DESC
LIMIT 5

问题: 2025年第一季度销售额超过10000元的商品品类
考察点: 时间过滤 分组聚合 HAVING
模型SQL:
SELECT p.category AS 商品品类, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE d.quarter = 'Q1'
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING SUM(o.order_amount) > 10000

问题: 各省份的客单价排名

模型SQL: SELECT r.province AS 省份, AVG(o.order_amount) AS 客单价, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.order_amount) DESC) AS 客单价排名 FROM dim_region r JOIN fact_order o ON r.region_id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.province;
